verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart. The diamond photo mosaic has been reduced to empty white diamond outlines that leave a dead hole on the left, and the city photo is now a small plain rectangle. The date diamond is clipped at the right edge, the underline rule floats away from the headline, the body copy is tiny, and the vertical URL sits jammed between the elements. B keeps the original intact, but it is just the portrait layout shrunk and centred, with wide empty white bands on the left and right. The mosaic ends unevenly at the bottom, so the result does not suit the square format; B is less bad, but it is still not a real resize.
